## Summary

Describe the problem and the change.

## Tests

- [ ] `swift build -c release -Xswiftc -warnings-as-errors`
- [ ] `swift test`
- [ ] `swift format lint --recursive Sources Tests`
- [ ] Added or updated a regression test for a behavior change

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and the commits are atomic.
- [ ] No new runtime dependency.
- [ ] User-visible strings are in the localization catalog with English and Russian entries.
- [ ] No personal paths, secrets, or private library screenshots.
- [ ] Documentation and CHANGELOG are updated when needed.
